title: Junk.  Warped and scratched within days of purchase.
text: Junk.  Warped and scratched within days of purchase.. Garbage.  Complete waste of money.  I have only had this pan less than a month when it was so warped it wouldn’t sit flat on the stove top. The nonstick is scratched in peeling. I am not terribly hard on pans and I do love to cook.  I expect more from this brand. It’s not worth contacting them I’m sure they wouldn’t do anything anyway. I wouldn’t want another one because it this point it’s just clutter in my kitchen. I never reach for this pan anymore and I’ve only had it a short period of time. Do yourself a favor and look elsewhere. Based on this experience I will never purchase another Farberware product again.
